title: Concept: SVG use element referencing an external document
description: A use element whose href points at another origin in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: An external document supplies the graphic and any script it carries, so a compromised host controls part of the rendering inside the bank's page.
applicability: Deployments that render a use element whose href points at another origin into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: An external document supplies the graphic and any script it carries, so a compromised host controls part of the rendering inside the bank's page.
